现在几点？ (Xiànzài jǐ diǎn?) - What time is it now?
现在八点十八分。 (Xiànzài bā diǎn shíbā fēn.) - It is 8:18 now.
你几点吃早饭？ (Nǐ jǐ diǎn chī zǎofàn?) - What time do you eat breakfast?
我七点吃早饭。 (Wǒ qī diǎn chī zǎofàn.) - I eat breakfast at seven o'clock.
昨天北京的天气怎么样？ (Zuótiān Běijīng de tiānqì zěnmeyàng?) - How was the weather in Beijing yesterday?
太热了。 (Tài rè le.) - It was too hot.
明天呢？ (Míngtiān ne?) - What about tomorrow?
明天天气怎么样？ (Míngtiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?) - What will the weather be like tomorrow?
明天天气很好，不冷不热。 (Míngtiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, bù lěng bú rè.) - The weather tomorrow will be fine, neither cold nor hot.
今天会下雨吗？ (Jīntiān huì xià yǔ ma?) - Will it rain today?
今天不会下雨。 (Jīntiān bú huì xià yǔ.) - It won't rain today.
王小姐今天会来吗？ (Wáng xiǎojiě jīntiān huì lái ma?) - Will Miss Wang come today?
不会来，天气太冷了。 (Bú huì lái, tiānqì tài lěng le.) - No, she won't come. The weather is too cold.

你多吃些水果，多喝水。 (Nǐ duō chī xiē shuǐguǒ, duō hē shuǐ.) - Eat more fruit and drink more water.
